title: NAMC: one site for a national conference
summaryLead: One site for tickets, sponsors, the schedule and attendee passes.
story: The National Association of Minority Contractors runs big national gatherings with a small admin team. Tickets, sponsorships, schedules and attendee access lived in different places, and peak registration was when it hurt most. They asked for one event site that could handle all of it. We built it as a fast static site on Netlify, with serverless forms for sponsor applications, a calendar download for the agenda, a way for small businesses to find the right meetings, and a digital pass for every attendee.
goals: Put tickets, sponsorships and the schedule in one place.
Take pressure off a small admin team during peak registration.
Give every attendee a digital pass and a way to find the right meetings.

features.title: Tickets and sponsorships
features.text: Sponsors pick a tier and upload their logo. The admin team gets the details.
features.story: Sponsors choose a tier and send vector logo files through a form. It checks the files and notifies the admin team, so nobody is chasing attachments by email.

features.title: Schedule with calendar sync
features.text: A schedule that's easy to scan on a phone, with a one-tap calendar download.
features.story: People want to see the day on their phone and keep it. One tap makes a calendar file that Apple, Google and Outlook all open.

features.title: Meeting finder
features.text: Helps small businesses find the meetings worth their time.

features.title: Digital pass
features.text: Every attendee gets a digital pass.

features.title: Accessible
features.text: Built to WCAG 2.1 AA, with keyboard and screen reader support.
